WITH daily AS (
    SELECT item_sk, d_date,
           SUM(web_sale_price) AS web_daily,
           SUM(store_sale_price) AS store_daily,
           SUM(is_web) AS web_cnt,
           SUM(is_store) AS store_cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
               d_date,
               ws_sales_price AS web_sale_price,
               NULL::numeric AS store_sale_price,
               1 AS is_web,
               0 AS is_store
        FROM web_sales
        INNER JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
        WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212+11
          AND ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
               d_date,
               NULL::numeric AS web_sale_price,
               ss_sales_price AS store_sale_price,
               0 AS is_web,
               1 AS is_store
        FROM store_sales
        INNER JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
        WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212+11
          AND ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    ) AS sales
    GROUP BY item_sk, d_date
)
SELECT item_sk, d_date, web_sales, store_sales, web_cumulative, store_cumulative
FROM (
    SELECT item_sk, d_date,
           CASE WHEN web_cnt > 0 THEN web_running ELSE NULL END AS web_sales,
           CASE WHEN store_cnt > 0 THEN store_running ELSE NULL END AS store_sales,
           MAX(CASE WHEN web_cnt > 0 THEN web_running END) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS web_cumulative,
           MAX(CASE WHEN store_cnt > 0 THEN store_running END) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS store_cumulative
    FROM (
        SELECT item_sk, d_date, web_daily, store_daily, web_cnt, store_cnt,
               SUM(web_daily) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS web_running,
               SUM(store_daily) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS store_running
        FROM daily
    ) AS running
) AS y
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
